translations.idiomatic: The main army pressed the advantage and struck fiercely, beheading more than ten thousand.

sentences.zh: 以功加步軍都軍頭，遷神衛軍都校，領敘州刺史。

translations.literal: For his merit he was promoted to chief commander of the infantry army, transferred to chief commander of the Shenwei army, and made prefect of Xu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was promoted to chief commander of the infantry army, made chief commander of the Shenwei army, and granted the post of prefect of Xu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，從潘美北征，至雁門、西陘，路與契丹遇，又戰敗之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi, following Pan Mei on the northern campaign, at Yanmen and Xijing they encountered the Khitan on the road and again defeated them in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongxi he followed Pan Mei on the northern campaign. At Yanmen and Xijing they encountered the Khitan on the road and defeated them again.

sentences.zh: 追至寰州，斬首五百餘級，其將趙彥辛以城降。

translations.literal: Pursuing to Huan prefecture, they beheaded more than five hundred; the Khitan general Zhao Yanxin surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing to Huan prefecture, they beheaded more than five hundred. The Khitan general Zhao Yanxin surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 超連被創，流血濡甲縷，部分軍士自若，乘勝抵應州，其節度副使艾正以城降。

translations.literal: Chao was wounded repeatedly; blood soaked the threads of his armor; he deployed the troops as calmly as ever, pressed the victory to Ying prefecture, and its military governor's deputy Ai Zheng surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Chao was wounded repeatedly, blood soaking the threads of his armor, yet he deployed his troops as calmly as ever. Pressing the victory to Ying prefecture, he took the surrender of military governor's deputy Ai Zheng.

sentences.zh: 還，加馬步軍都軍頭。

translations.literal: Upon return he was promoted to chief commander of the cavalry and infantry army.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was promoted to chief commander of the cavalry and infantry army.

sentences.zh: 淳化初，屯鎮州，遷天武指揮使，領澄州團練使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chunhua he garrisoned Zhen prefecture, was transferred to commander of the Tianwu command, and made regimental commissioner of Cheng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chunhua era he garrisoned Zhen prefecture, was promoted to commander of the Tianwu regiment, and made regimental commissioner of Cheng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 至道元年卒，年五十七。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhidao he died, aged fifty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the first year of Zhidao, aged fifty-seven.

sentences.zh: 丁罕者，潁州人。

translations.literal: Ding Han was a man of Ying prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Han was from Ying prefecture.

sentences.zh: 應募補衛士，累遷指揮使。

translations.literal: Answering the call for recruits he was appointed a guardsman, and was repeatedly promoted to commander.
translations.idiomatic: He enlisted as a guardsman and was repeatedly promoted to commander.

sentences.zh: 從劉廷翰戰徐河，以奪橋功，遷本軍都虞候。

translations.literal: Following Liu Tinghan in the battle at Xu River, for the merit of seizing the bridge he was promoted to deputy commander of his army.
translations.idiomatic: Following Liu Tinghan at the Battle of Xu River, he was promoted to deputy commander of his regiment for the merit of seizing the bridge.

sentences.zh: 累遷天武指揮使，領獎州團練使。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to commander of the Tianwu command and made regimental commissioner of Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to commander of the Tianwu regiment and regimental commissioner of Jiang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 淳化三年，出為澤州團練使、知霸州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Chunhua he was sent out as regimental commissioner of Ze prefecture and prefect of Ba prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chunhua he was posted as regimental commissioner of Ze prefecture and prefect of Ba prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會河溢壞城壘，罕以私錢募築，民咸德之。

translations.literal: When the river overflowed and destroyed the city ramparts, Han used his private funds to hire labor for repairs, and the people all were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: When the river overflowed and destroyed the city walls, Han used his own money to hire repairs, and the people were deeply grateful.

sentences.zh: 五年，以容州觀察使領靈環路行營都部署，與李繼遷戰，斬首俘獲以數萬計。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, as observation commissioner of Rong prefecture he was made overall deployment commissioner of the Linghuan route field headquarters; fighting Li Jiyuan, beheadings and captures numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he served as observation commissioner of Rong prefecture and overall deployment commissioner of the Linghuan route field headquarters. Fighting Li Jiyuan, he took tens of thousands of heads and captives.

sentences.zh: 至道中，率兵從大將李繼隆出青岡峽，賊聞先遁，追十日程，不見而返。

translations.literal: During Zhidao he led troops following the great general Li Jilong out through Qinggang Gorge; the bandits heard and fled first; he pursued for ten days' march, saw nothing, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhidao era he led troops under General Li Jilong out through Qinggang Gorge. The rebels fled at the news. After ten days' pursuit without finding them, he returned.

sentences.zh: 三年，真拜密州觀察使、知威虜軍，徙貝州。

translations.literal: In the third year he was formally appointed observation commissioner of Mi prefecture and commander of the Weilu army, then transferred to Bei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was formally appointed observation commissioner of Mi prefecture and commander of the Weilu army, then transferred to Bei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Xianping.

sentences.zh: 子守德，能世其家。

translations.literal: His son Shoude was able to carry on the family tradition.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shoude was able to carry on the family tradition.

sentences.zh: 趙瑫者，貝州清河人。

translations.literal: Zhao Tao was a man of Qinghe in Bei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Tao was from Qinghe in Bei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 由衛士累遷龍衛指揮使。

translations.literal: From guardsman he was repeatedly promoted to commander of the Longwei command.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a guardsman, he rose to commander of the Longwei regiment.

sentences.zh: 亦以徐河戰功，加鎮州團練使，至兵馬部署。

translations.literal: Also for merit at the Battle of Xu River he was promoted to regimental commissioner of Zhen prefecture, reaching deployment commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He too was rewarded for service at the Battle of Xu River with promotion to regimental commissioner of Zhen prefecture and eventually deployment commissioner.

sentences.zh: 至道二年卒於官，年七十。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidao he died in office, aged seventy.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office in the second year of Zhidao, aged seventy.

sentences.zh: 贈歸義軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the post of military governor of the Guiyi army.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title of military governor of the Guiyi army.

sentences.zh: 郭密，貝州經城人。

translations.literal: Guo Mi was a native of Jingcheng in Bei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Mi was from Jingcheng in Bei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 軀幹雄偉，膂力絕人。

translations.literal: His frame was imposing and his physical strength surpassed other men.
translations.idiomatic: He had an imposing build and physical strength that surpassed other men.

sentences.zh: 幼孤，隨母適同郡王乙，因冒姓王氏。

translations.literal: Orphaned in childhood, he followed his mother in marrying Wang Yi of the same prefecture and therefore took the surname Wang.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned in childhood, he followed his mother in marrying Wang Yi of the same prefecture and took the surname Wang.

sentences.zh: 以知瀛州馬仁瑀薦，隸晉王帳下，給事左右。

translations.literal: Recommended by Ma Renyu, prefect of Ying prefecture, he was enrolled in the Prince of Jin retinue and served in attendance at court.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended by Ma Renyu, prefect of Ying prefecture, he was enrolled in the Prince of Jin retinue and served in attendance.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，補指揮使，復姓郭氏。

translations.literal: When Taizong acceded he was appointed a commander and restored the surname Guo.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong came to the throne he was appointed a commander and restored the surname Guo.

sentences.zh: 至淳化間，凡八遷，移貝州駐泊兵馬部署。

translations.literal: By the Chunhua era he had been transferred eight times in all and was moved to deployment commissioner of the garrison forces stationed at Bei prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: By the Chunhua era he had been transferred eight times and was posted as deployment commissioner of the garrison forces stationed at Bei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會夏人寇邊，以密有武略，擢領安州觀察使，充靈州兵馬都部署。

translations.literal: When the Xia people raided the frontier, because Mi had military talent he was promoted to observation commissioner of An prefecture and made overall deployment commissioner of the Lingzhou forces.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xia raided the frontier, Mi was promoted to observation commissioner of An prefecture and made overall deployment commissioner of the Lingzhou forces for his military talent.

sentences.zh: 訓練士卒，號令嚴肅，夏人畏服，邊境賴以寧謐。

translations.literal: He trained the soldiers with strict and solemn commands; the Xia feared and submitted, and the frontier relied on him for tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: He trained the soldiers with strict discipline. The Xia feared and submitted, and the frontier was kept tranquil through his efforts.

sentences.zh: 至道二年卒，年五十八。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidao he died, aged fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Zhidao (996), aged fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 贈保順軍節度。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the post of military governor of the Baoshun army.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title of military governor of the Baoshun army.

sentences.zh: 傅思讓者，冀州信都人。

translations.literal: Fu Sirang was a man of Xindu in Ji prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Sirang was from Xindu in Ji prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少無賴，有勇力，善騎射。

translations.literal: In youth he was unruly, possessed courage and strength, and was skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: As a young man he was unruly but possessed courage and strength and was skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 太宗居晉邸，補親事都校。

translations.literal: When Taizong resided at the Prince of Jin establishment, Sirang was appointed commandant of personal attendants.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong resided at the Prince of Jin establishment, Sirang was appointed commandant of personal attendants.

sentences.zh: 即位，補衛士直長，累遷至平州刺史。

translations.literal: When Taizong acceded he was appointed chief of the guards direct company and was repeatedly promoted until he reached prefect of Ping prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong came to the throne he was appointed chief of the guards direct company and rose to prefect of Ping prefecture.

sentences.zh: 奉詔破契丹兵於唐興口。

translations.literal: By imperial order he defeated Khitan troops at Tangxing Ford.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order he defeated Khitan troops at Tangxing Ford.

sentences.zh: 端拱中，四遷為容州觀察使、知莫州，移隴州。

translations.literal: During Duangong, after four transfers he became observation commissioner of Rong prefecture and governor of Mo prefecture, then was moved to Long prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During the Duangong era, after four transfers he became observation commissioner of Rong prefecture and governor of Mo prefecture, then was transferred to Long prefecture.

sentences.zh: 上命殿中丞林特同判州事，以夾輔之，以思讓所為多不法故也。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Palace Attendant Lin Te to jointly decide prefectural affairs to assist and restrain him, because Sirang's conduct was often unlawful.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Palace Attendant Lin Te to jointly decide prefectural affairs to assist and restrain him, because Sirang's conduct was often unlawful.

sentences.zh: 至道二年卒，年七十四。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidao he died, aged seventy-four.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the second year of Zhidao (996), aged seventy-four.

sentences.zh: 贈保順軍節度。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the post of military governor of the Baoshun army.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title of military governor of the Baoshun army.

sentences.zh: 李斌者，青州人。

translations.literal: Li Bin was a man of Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bin was from Qing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 太宗在晉邸，聞其狀貌魁偉，召置左右。

translations.literal: When Taizong was at the Prince of Jin establishment, hearing that his stature and appearance were imposing, he summoned him and placed him in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong was at the Prince of Jin establishment, hearing that Bin was imposing in stature and appearance, he summoned him into attendance.

sentences.zh: 即位，補御龍直副指揮使。

translations.literal: When Taizong acceded he was appointed deputy commander of the Imperial Dragon Direct.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong came to the throne he was appointed deputy commander of the Imperial Dragon Direct.

sentences.zh: 太平興國中，以天武指揮使領鄭州刺史。

translations.literal: During Taiping Xingguo, as commander of the Tianwu regiment he concurrently held prefect of Zheng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taiping Xingguo era he served as commander of the Tianwu regiment and concurrently as prefect of Zheng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七年，坐嘗受秦王廷美饋遺，貶曹州都校。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because he had once accepted gifts from Prince Qin Tingmei, he was demoted to chief commander of Cao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, because he had once accepted gifts from Prince Qin Tingmei, he was demoted to chief commander of Cao prefecture.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，遷營州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi he was transferred to prefect of Ying prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongxi (986) he was transferred to prefect of Ying prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年，領溪州團練使，連為貝、冀二州駐泊都監。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he held regimental commissioner of Xi prefecture and served in succession as overall overseer of the garrisons stationed at Bei and Ji prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he served as regimental commissioner of Xi prefecture and in succession as overall overseer of the garrisons stationed at Bei and Ji prefectures.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，繼領萊州、洺州團練使。

translations.literal: During Chunhua he then held regimental commissioner of Lai and Ming prefectures in succession.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chunhua era he then served in succession as regimental commissioner of Lai and Ming prefectures.

sentences.zh: 勤於政理，人服其清慎，轉運使陳緯以狀聞於朝。

translations.literal: Diligent in governance, people respected his integrity and caution; transport commissioner Chen Wei reported his record to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Diligent in governance, people respected his integrity and caution, and transport commissioner Chen Wei reported his record to the court.

sentences.zh: 至道初，拜桂州觀察使，仍判洺州，徙滄州。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhidao he was appointed observation commissioner of Gui prefecture, still acting at Ming prefecture, then transferred to Cang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhidao era he was appointed observation commissioner of Gui prefecture while still acting at Ming prefecture, then transferred to Cang prefecture.

sentences.zh: 及代，吏民不忍其去，鄰境亦上其善狀，詔書褒美之。

translations.literal: When he was replaced, officials and people could not bear his departure, and neighboring jurisdictions also submitted reports of his good conduct; an imperial edict praised him.
translations.idiomatic: When he was replaced, officials and people could not bear his departure, and neighboring jurisdictions also submitted reports of his good conduct. An imperial edict praised him.

sentences.zh: 咸平三年卒，年六十一。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianping he died, aged sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the third year of Xianping (1000), aged sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 田仁朗，大名元城人。

translations.literal: Tian Renlang was a native of Yuancheng in Daming.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Renlang was from Yuancheng in Daming.

sentences.zh: 父武，仕晉昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: His father Wu served as military governor of the Zhaoyi army under Jin.
translations.idiomatic: His father Wu had served as military governor of the Zhaoyi army under Jin.

sentences.zh: 仁朗以父任西頭供奉官。

translations.literal: Renlang entered office through his father's privilege as a western-head palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Renlang entered office through his father's privilege as a western-head palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 太祖即位，從討李重進，攻城有功，還，與右神武統軍陳承昭浚五丈河，以通漕運。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizu acceded, Renlang followed in the campaign against Li Zhongjin and had merit in storming cities; on return, together with Chen Chengzhao, overall commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, he dredged the Wuzhang River to open transport by canal.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizu came to the throne, Renlang followed the campaign against Li Zhongjin and distinguished himself in storming cities. On his return he and Chen Chengzhao, overall commander of the Right Divine Martial Army, dredged the Wuzhang River to open canal transport.

sentences.zh: 乾德中，討蜀，命仁朗為鳳州路壕砦都監。

translations.literal: During Qiande, in the campaign against Shu, Renlang was appointed overall supervisor of trenches and stockades on the Fengzhou route.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qiande era, in the campaign against Shu, Renlang was appointed overall supervisor of trenches and stockades on the Fengzhou route.

sentences.zh: 伐木除道，大軍以濟，錄功遷染院副使。

translations.literal: He felled trees and cleared the road so the main army could cross; his merit was recorded and he was promoted to deputy commissioner of the Dyeing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He felled trees and cleared a road so the main army could pass, and for this service was promoted to deputy commissioner of the Dyeing Bureau.

sentences.zh: 太祖征太原，與陳承昭壅汾水灌城。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizu campaigned against Taiyuan, together with Chen Chengzhao he dammed the Fen River to flood the city.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Taizu campaigned against Taiyuan, he and Chen Chengzhao dammed the Fen River to flood the city.

sentences.zh: 城將陷，會班師。

translations.literal: The city was about to fall when the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The city was about to fall when the army was ordered to withdraw.

sentences.zh: 俄遷內染院使，數日，改左藏庫使。

translations.literal: Shortly he was transferred to commissioner of the Inner Dyeing Bureau; within days he was changed to commissioner of the Left Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was transferred to commissioner of the Inner Dyeing Bureau, and within days was reassigned as commissioner of the Left Treasury.

sentences.zh: 為中官所讒，太祖怒，立召詰之，至殿門，命去冠帶。

translations.literal: Slandered by a eunuch official, Emperor Taizu was angry, immediately summoned and interrogated him; when he reached the palace gate he was ordered to remove cap and belt.
translations.idiomatic: Slandered by a eunuch official, Emperor Taizu flew into a rage and immediately summoned him for interrogation. At the palace gate he was ordered to remove his cap and belt.

sentences.zh: 仁朗神色不撓，從容曰：「臣嘗從破蜀，秋毫無犯，陛下固知之。

translations.literal: Renlang's expression did not falter; calmly he said: "Your servant once followed in the conquest of Shu and did not violate so much as a hair's breadth — Your Majesty surely knows this.
translations.idiomatic: Renlang's expression did not falter. Calmly he said, "Your servant once followed in the conquest of Shu and did not violate so much as a hair's breadth—Your Majesty surely knows this.

sentences.zh: 今主藏禁中，豈復為姦利以自汙？」

translations.literal: Now I am in charge of the treasury within the palace — how could I again seek illicit profit and defile myself?"
translations.idiomatic: Now I am in charge of the treasury within the palace—how could I seek illicit profit and defile myself?"

sentences.zh: 太祖怒釋，止停其職。

translations.literal: Emperor Taizu's anger subsided; he only suspended him from office.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizu's anger subsided, and he only suspended him from office.

sentences.zh: 開寶六年，起為榷易使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kaibao he was restored to office as commissioner of the Monopoly Exchange.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Kaibao he was restored to office as commissioner of the Monopoly Exchange.

sentences.zh: 七年，以西北邊內侵，選知慶州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because the northwestern frontier was being invaded from within, he was selected to govern Qing prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, with the northwestern frontier under internal attack, he was selected to govern Qing prefecture.

sentences.zh: 仁朗至，率麾下往擊之，短兵將接，前鋒稍卻，仁朗斬指揮使二人，軍中震恐，爭乞效命，遂大破之。

translations.literal: When Renlang arrived he led his followers to attack them; as close combat was about to join, the vanguard fell back slightly; Renlang beheaded two commanders; the army was shaken with fear and all begged to give their lives; thus he routed them completely.
translations.idiomatic: When Renlang arrived he led his men to attack. As close combat was about to begin the vanguard fell back slightly. Renlang beheaded two commanders, throwing the army into terror; the men all begged to give their lives, and he routed the enemy completely.

sentences.zh: 其酋長相率請和，仁朗烹牛置酒與之約誓，邊境乃寧，璽書褒美。

translations.literal: Their chieftains one after another requested peace; Renlang boiled oxen and set out wine to covenant with them; the frontier was then tranquil, and an imperial letter praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Their chieftains one after another sued for peace. Renlang slaughtered oxen and set out wine to covenant with them, and the frontier was pacified. An imperial letter praised his achievement.

sentences.zh: 太平興國初，秦州羌為寇，命仁朗屯兵清水。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taiping Xingguo, the Qiang of Qin prefecture raided; Renlang was ordered to garrison troops at Qingshui.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Taiping Xingguo era, the Qiang of Qin prefecture raided, and Renlang was ordered to garrison troops at Qingshui.

sentences.zh: 會李飛雄事敗，召為西上閤門使。

translations.literal: When Li Feixiong's affair failed, Renlang was summoned to be commissioner of the Western Upper Gate.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Feixiong's plot failed, Renlang was summoned to serve as commissioner of the Western Upper Gate.

sentences.zh: 四年，征太原，命仁朗與閤門祗候劉緒按行太原城四面壕砦，閱視攻城梯衝、器械。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, campaigning against Taiyuan, Renlang was ordered together with Gate Attendant Liu Xu to inspect the trenches and stockades on all four sides of Taiyuan city and review siege ladders, rams, and equipment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the campaign against Taiyuan, Renlang and Gate Attendant Liu Xu were ordered to inspect the trenches and stockades on all four sides of Taiyuan and review siege ladders, rams, and equipment.

sentences.zh: 太原平，留仁朗為兵馬鈐轄，閑廄使武再興、軍器庫副使賈湜並為巡檢。

translations.literal: When Taiyuan was pacified, Renlang was left as military controller; Stable Commissioner Wu Zaixing and Deputy Commissioner of the Armory Jia Shi were both made inspectors.
translations.idiomatic: When Taiyuan was pacified, Renlang was left as military controller, with Stable Commissioner Wu Zaixing and Deputy Commissioner of the Armory Jia Shi as inspectors.

sentences.zh: 俄命仁朗與再興役民築榆次新城。

translations.literal: Shortly Renlang and Zaixing were ordered to conscript the people to build the new city of Yuci.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward Renlang and Zaixing were ordered to conscript labor to build the new city of Yuci.

sentences.zh: 從幸大名，又命為滄州鈐轄，俄遷東上閤門使、知秦州。

translations.literal: Following the imperial visit to Daming, he was again appointed military controller of Cang prefecture; shortly he was transferred to commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate and governor of Qin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Accompanying the imperial visit to Daming, he was appointed military controller of Cang prefecture, then shortly transferred to commissioner of the Eastern Upper Gate and governor of Qin prefecture.

sentences.zh: 九年，判四方館事。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was put in charge of the Four Directions Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was put in charge of the Four Directions Office.

sentences.zh: 會議東封，命仁朗自京抵泰山，督役治道。

translations.literal: When the eastern feng sacrifice was under discussion, Renlang was ordered to go from the capital to Mount Tai and supervise labor to prepare the road.
translations.idiomatic: When the eastern feng sacrifice was planned, Renlang was ordered to go from the capital to Mount Tai and supervise road construction.

sentences.zh: 李繼遷為亂，命仁朗率兵巡銀、夏，歲餘召還。

translations.literal: When Li Jiyuan rebelled, Renlang was ordered to lead troops on patrol in Yin and Xia; after more than a year he was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Jiyuan rebelled, Renlang was ordered to lead troops on patrol in Yin and Xia. After more than a year he was recalled.

sentences.zh: 未幾，繼遷攻麟州，誘殺曹光實，遂圍三族砦。

translations.literal: Before long Jiyuan attacked Lin prefecture, lured and killed Cao Guangshi, and then besieged the Sancu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Jiyuan attacked Lin prefecture, lured and killed Cao Guangshi, and then besieged the Sancu stockade.

sentences.zh: 命仁朗與閤門使王侁、副使董愿、宮苑使李繼隆，馳傳發邊兵數千擊之。

translations.literal: Renlang was ordered together with Gate Commissioner Wang Yi, Vice Commissioner Dong Yuan, and Park Commissioner Li Jilong to take express post-horses and dispatch several thousand frontier troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Renlang, Gate Commissioner Wang Yi, Vice Commissioner Dong Yuan, and Park Commissioner Li Jilong were ordered to ride express post-horses and dispatch several thousand frontier troops to attack them.

sentences.zh: 仁朗次綏州，奏請益兵，留月餘俟報。

translations.literal: Renlang halted at Sui prefecture, memorialized requesting additional troops, and remained more than a month awaiting a reply.
translations.idiomatic: Renlang halted at Sui prefecture, memorialized for reinforcements, and waited more than a month for a reply.

sentences.zh: 會三族砦將折遇乜殺監軍使者，與繼遷合。

translations.literal: At that time the Sancu stockade commander Zhe Yume killed the army inspector envoy and joined with Jiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Sancu stockade commander Zhe Yume killed the army inspector envoy and joined forces with Jiyuan.

sentences.zh: 太宗聞之大怒，亟遣軍器庫使劉文裕自三交乘疾置代仁朗。

translations.literal: When Emperor Taizong heard of it he was greatly angered and urgently dispatched Armory Commissioner Liu Wenyu from Sanjiao by express relay to replace Renlang.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong was greatly angered and urgently dispatched Armory Commissioner Liu Wenyu from Sanjiao by express relay to replace Renlang.

sentences.zh: 繼遷乘急攻撫寧砦，仁朗不知為文裕所代，喜謂諸將曰：「敵人逐水草散保岩險，常烏合為寇，勝則進，敗則走，無以窮其巢穴。

translations.literal: Jiyuan took advantage to press the attack on Funing stockade; Renlang did not know he had been replaced by Wenyu; pleased, he said to the generals: "The enemy follow water and grass, scatter and hold to cliffs and passes, and usually gather like crows to raid; if they win they advance, if they lose they flee — there is no way to exhaust their lair.
translations.idiomatic: Jiyuan pressed the attack on Funing stockade. Unaware that Wenyu had replaced him, Renlang said happily to the generals, "The enemy follow water and grass, scatter to hold cliffs and passes, and usually gather in loose bands to raid. If they win they advance; if they lose they flee. There is no way to exhaust their lair.

sentences.zh: 今繼遷嘯聚羌、戎數萬，盡銳以攻孤壘，撫寧小而固，兵少而精，未可以旬浹破。

translations.literal: Now Jiyuan has rallied tens of thousands of Qiang and Rong, bringing all his elite to attack a lone fort; Funing is small but solid, its troops few but picked — it cannot be taken in ten days.
translations.idiomatic: Now Jiyuan has rallied tens of thousands of Qiang and Rong and brought all his elite to attack a lone fort. Funing is small but solid, its garrison few but picked—it cannot be taken in ten days.

sentences.zh: 當留信宿，俟其困，以大兵臨之，分強弩三百，邀其歸路，必成擒矣。」

translations.literal: We should stay two nights, wait until they are exhausted, then bring the main army against them and detach three hundred strong crossbowmen to intercept their line of retreat — he will surely be captured."
translations.idiomatic: We should stay two nights, wait until they are exhausted, then bring the main army against them and detach three hundred strong crossbowmen to cut off their retreat. He will surely be captured."

sentences.zh: 仁朗部署已定，欲示閑暇，日縱其樗博，不恤軍事。

translations.literal: Renlang's dispositions were already settled; wishing to appear at leisure, day after day he allowed dice and gambling, not caring for military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Renlang's dispositions were already set. Wishing to appear at leisure, day after day he allowed dice and gambling and neglected military affairs.

sentences.zh: 上知之，遣使召仁朗赴闕，下御史按問仁朗請益兵及陷三族狀。

translations.literal: When the emperor learned of it he sent an envoy to summon Renlang to court and ordered the censorate to investigate Renlang's request for additional troops and the fall of the Sancu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor learned of this he summoned Renlang to court and ordered the censorate to investigate his request for reinforcements and the fall of the Sancu stockade.

sentences.zh: 仁朗對曰：「所召銀、綏、夏兵，其州皆留防城，不遣。

translations.literal: Renlang replied: "The troops summoned from Yin, Sui, and Xia — each prefecture kept them for city defense and did not send them.
translations.idiomatic: Renlang replied, "The troops summoned from Yin, Sui, and Xia were all kept for city defense and not sent.

sentences.zh: 所部有千餘人，皆曹光實舊卒，器甲不完，故請益兵。

translations.literal: The troops under my command numbered a little over a thousand, all former soldiers of Cao Guangshi, with incomplete armor and weapons — therefore I requested additional troops.
translations.idiomatic: The troops under my command numbered a little over a thousand, all former soldiers of Cao Guangshi, with incomplete armor and weapons. That is why I requested reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 況轉輸芻粟未備，三族砦與綏相去道遠，非元詔所救。

translations.literal: Moreover transport of fodder and grain was not ready; Sancu stockade was far from Sui by road — it was not within the original edict's scope of rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover transport of fodder and grain was not ready, and Sancu stockade was far from Sui by road—it was not within the original orders for rescue.

sentences.zh: 昨臣已定擒繼遷策，會詔代臣，其謀不果。」

translations.literal: Yesterday your servant had already settled a plan to capture Jiyuan; then an edict replaced me, and the plan did not succeed."
translations.idiomatic: I had already settled a plan to capture Jiyuan, but then an edict replaced me and the plan came to nothing."

sentences.zh: 因言：「繼遷得部落情，願降優詔懷來之，或以厚利啖諸酋長密圖之。

translations.literal: He then said: "Jiyuan has won the hearts of the tribes; I wish to submit that a gracious edict be sent to win him over, or that generous rewards be used to entice the various chieftains to plot against him secretly.
translations.idiomatic: He then said, "Jiyuan has won the hearts of the tribes. I urge that a gracious edict be sent to win him over, or that generous rewards be used to entice the chieftains to plot against him in secret.

sentences.zh: 不爾，恐他日難制，大為邊患。」

translations.literal: Otherwise I fear that in days to come he will be hard to control and will become a great frontier calamity."
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise I fear that in time he will be hard to control and become a great frontier menace."

sentences.zh: 御史以其狀聞，上大怒，切責憲府官吏曰：「仁朗不恤軍政，得為過乎？」

translations.literal: The censorate reported his statement; the emperor was greatly angered and sharply rebuked the censorate officials, saying: "Renlang did not care for military affairs — can this be excused?"
translations.idiomatic: The censorate reported his statement. The emperor was greatly angered and sharply rebuked the censorate officials: "Renlang neglected military affairs—can this be excused?"

sentences.zh: 大理遂當仁朗乏軍興及征人違期二十日以上，坐死，上特貸之，下詔責授商州團練副使，馳驛發遣。

translations.literal: The Court of Judicial Review then found Renlang guilty of failing to supply the army and of troops exceeding the deadline by more than twenty days, punishable by death; the emperor specially pardoned him, issued an edict of rebuke appointing him deputy regimental commissioner of Shang prefecture, and sent him off by express post.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Judicial Review found Renlang guilty of failing to supply the army and of troops exceeding the deadline by more than twenty days, a capital offense. The emperor specially pardoned him, issued a rebuking edict appointing him deputy regimental commissioner of Shang prefecture, and sent him off by express post.

sentences.zh: 是役也，仁朗計已決，為王侁等所構，逗撓不進軍，故及於貶。

translations.literal: In this campaign Renlang's plan was already settled, but he was framed by Wang Yi and others for dalliance and failure to advance the army, and therefore suffered demotion.
translations.idiomatic: In this campaign Renlang's plan was already settled, but he was framed by Wang Yi and others for dalliance and failure to advance, and therefore suffered demotion.

sentences.zh: 後數月，上知其無罪，召拜右神武軍大將軍。

translations.literal: Several months later the emperor knew he was innocent and summoned him, appointing him great general of the Right Shenwu army.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later, knowing he was innocent, the emperor summoned him and appointed him great general of the Right Shenwu army.

sentences.zh: 部修河北東路諸州城池，數月而就。

translations.literal: He supervised repairs to the city walls of the various prefectures on the eastern Hebei route, completing the work in several months.
translations.idiomatic: He supervised repairs to the city walls of the eastern Hebei prefectures, completing the work in several months.

sentences.zh: 留知雄州，加領澄州刺史。

translations.literal: He was retained to govern Xiong prefecture and additionally granted the post of prefect of Cheng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was retained as governor of Xiong prefecture and additionally granted the post of prefect of Cheng prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時河北用兵，大藩多用節將，朝議以通判權位不倫，選諸司使有吏幹者佐之，以仁朗知定州節度副使事。

translations.literal: At that time Hebei was at war; great prefectures mostly used military governors; court opinion held that vice-prefects' rank and authority were unequal; those among the various bureau commissioners with administrative ability were selected to assist them — Renlang was made acting military governor's deputy of Ding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Hebei was at war and great prefectures mostly had military governors. Court opinion held that vice-prefects' rank was unequal to the task, so bureau commissioners with administrative ability were selected to assist them. Renlang was made acting military governor's deputy of Ding prefecture.

sentences.zh: 俄召赴闕，未聞命而卒，年六十，時端拱二年也。

translations.literal: Shortly he was summoned to court; before receiving appointment he died, aged sixty — it was the second year of Duangong.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he was summoned to court but died before receiving new appointment, aged sixty, in the second year of Duangong.

sentences.zh: 仁朗性沉厚，有謀略。

translations.literal: Renlang's nature was deep and steady, with strategic ability.
translations.idiomatic: Renlang was deep and steady in character, with strategic ability.

sentences.zh: 頗涉書傳，所至有善政。

translations.literal: He had considerable acquaintance with books and classics; wherever he went he had good administration.
translations.idiomatic: He was well read in the classics and wherever he served governed well.

sentences.zh: 雅好音律，尤臻其妙。

translations.literal: He elegantly loved music and reached its utmost refinement.
translations.idiomatic: He had an elegant love of music and attained its utmost refinement.

sentences.zh: 時內職中咸以仁朗為稱首，故死之日人多惜之。

translations.literal: At that time among the inner service ranks all regarded Renlang as foremost; therefore on the day of his death many regretted his passing.
translations.idiomatic: Among the inner service ranks all regarded Renlang as foremost, and many mourned his passing.

sentences.zh: 劉謙，博州堂邑人。

translations.literal: Liu Qian was a native of Tangyi in Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qian was from Tangyi in Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 曾祖直，以純厚聞於鄉黨，里有盜其衣者，置不問。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Zhi was known in the village and neighborhood for pure sincerity and generosity; when someone in the hamlet stole his clothes, he let the matter pass without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Zhi was known in the village for pure sincerity and generosity. When someone in the hamlet stole his clothes, he let the matter pass without inquiry.

sentences.zh: 州將廉知，俾人故竊其衣，亦不訴理，即召詰前盜衣者，俾還之。

translations.literal: The prefect Lian Zhi had someone deliberately steal his clothes again; he still did not bring suit, but immediately summoned and questioned the earlier clothes-thief and had him return them.
translations.idiomatic: Prefect Lian Zhi had someone deliberately steal his clothes again. He still did not bring suit but immediately summoned the earlier thief and had him return them.

sentences.zh: 直紿云：「衣乃自以遺少年，非竊也。」

translations.literal: Zhi deceived them, saying: "The clothes were given by me to a young man of my own accord — it was not theft."
translations.idiomatic: Zhi deceived them, saying, "I gave the clothes to a young man of my own accord—it was not theft."

sentences.zh: 州將義之，賜以金帛，不受而去。

translations.literal: The prefect admired his righteousness, bestowed gold and silk on him, but he did not accept and departed.
translations.idiomatic: The prefect admired his righteousness and bestowed gold and silk on him, but he refused and departed.

sentences.zh: 父仁罕，輕俠自任。

translations.literal: His father Renhan was a man who took pride in being bold and chivalrous.
translations.idiomatic: His father Renhan was a man who took pride in bold, chivalrous conduct.

sentences.zh: 五代末，寇盜充斥，仁罕率眾斷澶州浮橋以潰賊，因誘獲數十人，出芻粟給官軍。

translations.literal: At the end of the Five Dynasties, bandits and robbers filled the land; Renhan led a crowd to cut the pontoon bridge at Cao prefecture to rout the bandits, and by luring them captured several tens of men, then supplied fodder and grain to the government army.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Five Dynasties, bandits filled the land. Renhan led a crowd to cut the pontoon bridge at Cao prefecture and rout the rebels, lured and captured several dozen men, and supplied fodder and grain to the government army.

sentences.zh: 補內黃鎮將。

translations.literal: He was appointed garrison commander of Neihuang.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed garrison commander of Neihuang.

sentences.zh: 嘗因事至酒家，遇群寇暴集，以計悉梟其首，攜詣西京留守向拱，補汜水鎮將，俄為散都頭。

translations.literal: Once on business he went to a wine shop and encountered a band of robbers gathering suddenly; by stratagem he beheaded them all, carried the heads to Western Capital garrison commander Xiang Gong, was appointed garrison commander of Sishui, and shortly became a roving company chief.
translations.idiomatic: Once on business he went to a wine shop and encountered a band of robbers gathering suddenly. By stratagem he beheaded them all, carried the heads to Western Capital garrison commander Xiang Gong, was appointed garrison commander of Sishui, and shortly became a roving company chief.

sentences.zh: 宋初，遷許州龍衛副指揮使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song he was transferred to deputy commander of the Longwei command in Xu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Song he was promoted to deputy commander of the Longwei regiment in Xu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 會王師征廣南，為前鋒。

translations.literal: When the imperial army campaigned against Guangnan, he served as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army campaigned against Guangnan, he served as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 還，改同州都校，卒。

translations.literal: Upon return he was changed to chief commander of Tong prefecture, then died.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was made chief commander of Tong prefecture, then died.

sentences.zh: 謙少感概，不拘小節。

translations.literal: Qian in youth was stirred by high ideals and did not constrain himself by petty proprieties.
translations.idiomatic: As a young man Qian was stirred by high ideals and did not constrain himself by petty proprieties.

sentences.zh: 初詣嶺表省父，仁罕資以金帛，令北歸行商。

translations.literal: At first he went to the Lingnan region to visit his father; Renhan supplied him with gold and silk and told him to return north and engage in trade.
translations.idiomatic: At first he went south to visit his father. Renhan supplied him with gold and silk and told him to return north and engage in trade.

sentences.zh: 還堂邑舊墅，嘗為鄉里惡少所辱，謙不勝怒，毆殺之。

translations.literal: Returning to his old estate at Tangyi, he was once insulted by local ruffians; Qian could not contain his anger and beat one to death.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to his old estate at Tangyi, he was once insulted by local ruffians. Qian could not contain his anger and beat one to death.

sentences.zh: 亡命京師，遂應募從軍，補衛士，稍遷內殿直都知。

translations.literal: He fled to the capital as a fugitive, then answered the call for recruits and joined the army, was appointed a guardsman, and was gradually promoted to director of the Inner Hall Straight guard.
translations.idiomatic: He fled to the capital as a fugitive, enlisted in the army, was appointed a guardsman, and gradually rose to director of the Inner Hall Straight guard.

sentences.zh: 至道初，真宗升儲邸，增補宮衛，太宗御便坐，親選諸校，授謙西頭供奉官、東宮親衛都知，賜袍笏、鞾帶、器幣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhidao, when Emperor Zhenzong was elevated to the heir's residence, palace guards were augmented; Emperor Taizong took the informal seat and personally selected the various commanders, appointing Qian Western Head Attendant Official and director of the Eastern Palace personal guard, bestowing robe and tablet, boots and belt, vessels and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Zhidao era, when Emperor Zhenzong was elevated to the heir's residence and palace guards were augmented, Emperor Taizong took the informal seat and personally selected the commanders. Qian was appointed Western Head Attendant Official and director of the Eastern Palace personal guard, and was given robe and tablet, boots and belt, vessels, and silks.

sentences.zh: 真宗即位，擢授洛苑使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhenzong ascended the throne, Qian was promoted and appointed Luoyang Park commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhenzong ascended the throne, Qian was promoted to Luoyang Park commissioner.

sentences.zh: 謙起行伍，不樂禁職，求換秩，改殿前左班指揮使，給諸司使奉料。

translations.literal: Qian had risen from the ranks and did not enjoy palace service; he requested a change of rank and was made commander of the Left Wing of the Palace Front, with the salary of a bureau commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Qian had risen from the ranks and did not enjoy palace service. He requested a change of rank and was made commander of the Left Wing of the Palace Front, with the salary of a bureau commissioner.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，遷御前忠佐馬步軍都軍頭，領勤州刺史，加殿前右班都虞候。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping he was transferred to chief commander of the Imperial Front Loyal Assistant cavalry and infantry army, made prefect of Qin prefecture, and additionally appointed deputy commander of the Right Wing of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianping era he was promoted to chief commander of the Imperial Front Loyal Assistant cavalry and infantry army, made prefect of Qin prefecture, and additionally appointed deputy commander of the Right Wing of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 上幸大名，至北苑，屬謙有疾，遣歸將護，謙懇請從行。

translations.literal: When the emperor visited Daming and reached the Northern Park, Qian happened to be ill; he was sent home to convalesce, but Qian earnestly requested to accompany the journey.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Daming and reached the Northern Park, Qian happened to be ill and was sent home to convalesce, but he earnestly requested to accompany the journey.

sentences.zh: 既俾其二子隨侍，仍挾尚醫以從，御廚調膳以給之。

translations.literal: His two sons were then ordered to attend him, and an imperial physician was sent along as well; the imperial kitchen prepared special meals to supply him.
translations.idiomatic: His two sons were ordered to attend him, an imperial physician was sent along, and the imperial kitchen prepared special meals for him.

sentences.zh: 疾瘳，毀所服鞍勒以遺中使，上聞，賜白金二百兩。

translations.literal: When his illness recovered he destroyed the saddle and bridle he had worn and gave them to the palace envoy; when the emperor heard of it he bestowed two hundred taels of white gold.
translations.idiomatic: When he recovered he destroyed the saddle and bridle he had worn and gave them to the palace envoy. When the emperor heard of it he bestowed two hundred taels of white gold.

sentences.zh: 駕還，改捧日左廂都指揮使，領本州團練使。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned, he was changed to commander of the Left Wing of the Sun-Bearer command and made regimental commissioner of his prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned, he was made commander of the Left Wing of the Sun-Bearer regiment and regimental commissioner of his prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷捧日、天武四廂都指揮使，領本州防禦使，權殿前都虞候。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to commander of all four wings of the Sun-Bearer and Tianwu commands, made defense commissioner of his prefecture, and given acting appointment as deputy commander of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was promoted to commander of all four wings of the Sun-Bearer and Tianwu regiments, made defense commissioner of his prefecture, and given acting appointment as deputy commander of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 時高翰為天武左廂都校，有卒負債殺人，瘞屍翰營中，累日，發土得之。

translations.literal: At that time Gao Han was chief commander of the Left Wing of the Tianwu command; a soldier, in debt, killed a man and buried the corpse in Han's camp; after several days the body was found when the earth was dug up.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Gao Han was chief commander of the Left Wing of the Tianwu regiment. A soldier in debt killed a man and buried the corpse in Han's camp. After several days the body was found when the earth was dug up.

sentences.zh: 上怒翰失檢察，執見於便殿。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry that Han had failed in inspection and had him brought before the informal hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry that Han had failed in inspection and had him brought before the informal hall.

sentences.zh: 謙即前奏：「翰職在巡邏及閱教諸軍，不時在營，本營事宜責之軍頭。」

translations.literal: Qian immediately stepped forward and memorialized: "Han's duty lies in patrolling and drilling the various armies; he is not always in camp — matters of the home camp should be charged to the company chief."
translations.idiomatic: Qian immediately stepped forward and said, "Han's duty lies in patrolling and drilling the various armies. He is not always in camp—matters of the home camp should be charged to the company chief."

sentences.zh: 上為釋翰罪。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon released Han from blame.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor thereupon released Han from blame.

sentences.zh: 景德初，加侍衛馬軍都虞候，改領潯州防禦使，俄權步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jingde he was promoted to deputy commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry army, changed to defense commissioner of Xun prefecture, and shortly given acting appointment as commander of the infantry army.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jingde era he was promoted to deputy commander of the Imperial Guard cavalry army, made defense commissioner of Xun prefecture, and shortly given acting appointment as commander of the infantry army.

sentences.zh: 明年冬，制授殿前副都指揮使、振武軍節度。

translations.literal: The next winter he was formally appointed deputy overall commander of the Palace Front and military governor of the Zhenwu army.
translations.idiomatic: The next winter he was formally appointed deputy overall commander of the Palace Front and military governor of the Zhenwu army.

sentences.zh: 先是，謙久權殿前都虞候，俄擢曹璨正授，謙頗形慨歎。

translations.literal: Earlier Qian had long held acting appointment as deputy commander of the Palace Front; shortly Cao Shen was promoted to formal appointment, and Qian showed considerable sighing regret.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Qian had long held acting appointment as deputy commander of the Palace Front. Shortly afterward Cao Shen received formal appointment, and Qian showed visible regret.

sentences.zh: 至是，璨副馬軍，而升謙領禁衛焉。

translations.literal: At this time Can became deputy of the cavalry army, while Qian was elevated to command the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Can became deputy of the cavalry army while Qian was elevated to command the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 河北屯兵，常以八月給冬衣。

translations.literal: Garrison troops in Hebei usually received winter clothing in the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison troops in Hebei usually received winter clothing in the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 謙上言邊城早寒，請給以六月，後以為例。

translations.literal: Qian memorialized that frontier cities grew cold early and requested issue in the sixth month; afterward this became precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Qian memorialized that frontier cities grew cold early and requested issue in the sixth month. This afterward became precedent.

sentences.zh: 無何，以足疾求典郡，上召見，敦勉之。

translations.literal: Before long, on account of foot ailment he requested appointment to govern a prefecture; the emperor summoned and received him, earnestly urging him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, citing foot ailment, he requested appointment to govern a prefecture. The emperor summoned him and earnestly urged him to remain.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符初，從東封，上升泰山，詔都總山下馬步諸軍，與西京左藏庫副使趙守倫閱視山門，設施有法，著籍者乃得上焉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Dazhong Xiangfu, following the eastern feng sacrifice, the emperor ascended Mount Tai; an edict ordered Qian to command all cavalry and infantry troops below the mountain, and together with Western Capital Left Treasury deputy commissioner Zhao Shoulun to inspect the mountain gates; arrangements were conducted by rule, and only those on the register were permitted to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Dazhong Xiangfu era, on the eastern feng sacrifice, the emperor ascended Mount Tai. An edict ordered Qian to command all cavalry and infantry below the mountain and, together with Western Capital Left Treasury deputy commissioner Zhao Shoulun, to inspect the mountain gates. Arrangements were conducted by rule, and only those on the register were permitted to ascend.

sentences.zh: 禮成，進授都指揮使，移領保靜軍節度。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed he was promoted to overall commander and transferred to military governor of the Baojing army.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were completed he was promoted to overall commander and transferred to military governor of the Baojing army.

sentences.zh: 明年八月卒，年六十，贈侍中。

translations.literal: The next year in the eighth month he died, aged sixty; he was posthumously granted the post of Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, in the eighth month, he died aged sixty. He was posthumously granted the title of Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 初，謙將應募，與同軍王仁德訊於日者。

translations.literal: At first, when Qian was about to enlist, he and Wang Rendé of the same army consulted a diviner by the day.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Qian was about to enlist, he and Wang Rendé of the same army consulted a diviner.

sentences.zh: 日者指謙謂仁德曰：「爾當為此人廄吏。」

translations.literal: The diviner pointed at Qian and said to Rendé: "You shall become this man's stable clerk."
translations.idiomatic: The diviner pointed at Qian and said to Rendé, "You shall become this man's stable clerk."

sentences.zh: 及謙帥殿前，仁德果隸役廄中。

translations.literal: When Qian came to command the Palace Front, Rendé indeed served in the stables.
translations.idiomatic: When Qian came to command the Palace Front, Rendé indeed served in the stables.

sentences.zh: 子懷懿，後為東染院副使。

translations.literal: His son Huaiyi later became deputy commissioner of the Eastern Dyeing Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: His son Huaiyi later became deputy commissioner of the Eastern Dyeing Bureau.

sentences.zh: 懷詮，內殿崇班、閤門祗候。

translations.literal: Huaiquan was an Inner Hall Honored Company officer and Gate Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Huaiquan was an Inner Hall Honored Company officer and Gate Attendant.

sentences.zh: 論曰：宋初諸將，率奮自草野，出身戎行，雖盜賊無賴，亦廁其間，與屠狗販繒者何以異哉？

translations.literal: The historians comment: The generals of early Song mostly rose vigorously from the wilds, emerging from military service; even thieves and ruffians were mixed among them — how were they different from dog-butcherers and silk-peddlers?
translations.idiomatic: The historians comment: The generals of early Song mostly rose vigorously from the wilds through military service. Even thieves and ruffians were mixed among them—how were they different from dog-butcherers and silk-peddlers?

sentences.zh: 及見於用，皆能卓卓自樹，由御之得其道也。

translations.literal: Yet once put to use, all were able to stand out and establish themselves — because they were governed by the proper method.
translations.idiomatic: Yet once put to use, all were able to distinguish themselves—because they were governed by the proper method.

sentences.zh: 劉福御下有方略，所至著績，受祿雖厚，而不為燕安之謀，可謂國爾忘家者矣。

translations.literal: Liu Fu had strategy in commanding subordinates; wherever he went he achieved notable results; though his salary was generous, he did not plan for ease and comfort — he may be called one who forgot his family for the sake of the state.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Fu had strategy in commanding subordinates and achieved notable results wherever he served. Though his salary was generous, he did not plan for ease and comfort—he may be called one who forgot his family for the sake of the state.

sentences.zh: 守忠練達邊事，禔身謙慎，弭卒校之變於談笑之頃，非善於行權者不能也。

translations.literal: Shouzhong was practiced and adept in frontier affairs, disciplined himself with humility and caution, and quelled mutiny among the officers in the space of a jest — none but one skilled in exercising expedient authority could do this.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhong was practiced in frontier affairs, disciplined himself with humility and caution, and quelled mutiny among the officers in the space of a jest—none but one skilled in exercising expedient authority could have done this.

sentences.zh: 仁朗沈毅有謀，累從征討，綏州之役，不惟無功，而反坐逗撓，豈其計之不善哉？

translations.literal: Renlang was deep, resolute, and strategic; he repeatedly followed campaigns — yet in the Sui prefecture campaign he not only achieved no merit but was instead convicted of dalliance; was his plan truly poor?
translations.idiomatic: Renlang was deep, resolute, and strategic, and repeatedly followed campaigns. Yet in the Sui prefecture campaign he not only achieved no merit but was convicted of dalliance. Was his plan truly poor?

sentences.zh: 特為讒邪所構爾。

translations.literal: He was simply framed by slanderous villains, that is all.
translations.idiomatic: He was simply framed by slanderous villains, that is all.

sentences.zh: 自餘諸子，皆積戰功以取通侯。

translations.literal: As for the rest, all accumulated battle merit to attain the rank of full marquis.
translations.idiomatic: As for the rest, all accumulated battle merit to attain the rank of full marquis.

sentences.zh: 若延美之開門示敵，思德之翼衛主帥，繼倫之襲擊契丹，薛超之裹創赴戰，元達之請赦亡命，郭密之訓撫士卒，斯皆忠義仁勇，有足稱者。

translations.literal: Such as Yanmei's opening the gate to show the enemy, Side's winging and guarding the commander-in-chief, Jilun's surprise attack on the Khitan, Chao's binding wounds and rushing to battle, Yuanda's petition to pardon fugitives, and Mi's training and comforting the soldiers — all these were loyal, righteous, benevolent, and brave, and merit praise.
translations.idiomatic: Such as Yanmei's opening the gate to show the enemy, Side's protecting the commander-in-chief, Jilun's surprise attack on the Khitan, Chao's binding his wounds and rushing to battle, Yuanda's petition to pardon fugitives, and Mi's training and comforting the soldiers—all were loyal, righteous, benevolent, and brave, and merit praise.

sentences.zh: 罕、瑫、思讓，若斌、若謙，雖乏奇功，而亦克共乃職，能寡過者也。

translations.literal: Han, Tao, and Sirang, as well as Bin and Qian, though lacking extraordinary merit, nevertheless were able to fulfill their duties together and commit few faults.
translations.idiomatic: Han, Tao, and Sirang, as well as Bin and Qian, though lacking extraordinary merit, nevertheless fulfilled their duties and committed few faults.

sentences.zh: 守正素練戎旅，累任邊要，而矜勞肆忿，視於勞謙之君子，能無愧乎。

translations.literal: Shouzheng was long practiced in military affairs and repeatedly held important frontier posts, yet he prided himself on his labors and indulged his anger — compared with gentlemen who toil yet remain humble, can he be without shame?
translations.idiomatic: Shouzheng was long practiced in military affairs and repeatedly held important frontier posts, yet he prided himself on his labors and indulged his anger. Compared with gentlemen who toil yet remain humble, can he be without shame?
